title: Explain delivery status
requestText: Explain what a completed Picard request establishes, in two sentences.
note: Reviewed source facts for this synthetic example: Completed means the relay saved a provider answer. It does not establish factual correctness, test success, deployment, or owner acceptance. A partial answer must be identified as incomplete.

acceptanceCriteria: Explain that completed indicates a saved answer.
Preserve the distinction from correctness, tests, deployment and owner acceptance.
constraints: Do not claim that any code was run or deployed.
